Moxie Monday

Seattle, WA · Downtown · Social · Mixed

Women / trans / femmeLGBTQ+No-dropBeginner friendly

Moxie Monday is a social group ride in Seattle, WA. It rolls first Monday of the month at 6:00 pm from Westlake Park. About 8–15 miles, casual, 10–12 mph on flats. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 10–12 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @moxiemonday the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Moxie Monday group ride

A ride for women, trans, femme and non-binary riders on any kind of bike. Casual pace, frequent regroups and breaks, usually under 20 miles. Meets at Westlake Park. The same crew runs an annual W/T/F alley cat.
